## Historical exposure

One viewer dataset was committed: `data/temporal/pilot/temporal_comment_pilot.parquet`, 1,474 rows; introduced by `ac6ce266c09498a7057558aa17c229593cad441a`, blob `64a74dcafd5af0ae5aa75a2043ea1c7e51596277`. Removing HEAD does not erase old clones/history. No automatic history rewrite is authorized.

No credential material was detected in the reachable Git objects examined by the initial audit. No credential rotation is indicated by these findings. This is a bounded scan, not proof against arbitrary unlabeled secrets.

The per-source private migration manifest and safe row counts will be recorded in `evidence/private_data_migration.json`. It contains source paths, counts and file digests, never viewer rows.
